description: This file defines functions and types for grouping and sharding test cases in a test runner, including logic for parallel execution, grouping by worker and require file, and filtering test groups for sharding.

methods.name: createTestGroups
methods.description: Groups test cases into test groups based on parallelism, worker hash, require file, and suite structure for optimized execution.

methods.name: filterForShard
methods.description: Filters test groups to assign them to a specific shard based on weights and total number of shards.
